blurb: At Cerberus Brewing Company, you’ll find a cool pub atmosphere, friendly staff and a laid-back vibe. You’ll also discover some of the most dynamic pub cuisine in Colorado Springs, award-winning beer brewed in house and a dining experience that ranges from casual beer garden hangouts to upscale date night dinners.
